answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 60703 Country: India Title: related to fasting Question: During Ramadan while referring to the masail of nikah I want to know the meaning of foreplay so I searched in Google and I saw some video and sperm ejected is my fast nullified. Answer ID: 60703 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 698/663/SN=10/1436) If you ejected semen merely by watching the video and you did not masturbate to eject it then your fast did not break in the above mentioned case. So you are not required to make its qaza. (Shami: 3/367) But it is noteworthy that in no way it is lawful to watch videos with pictures of women. You committed a big sin by watching video in the state of fast. You should do taubah from it wholeheartedly and avoid watching videos in future altogether. In case you want to know anything about religion then you should ask it any reliable scholar directly or by phone etc. Internet contains each types of information and until it is not confirmed by any reliable and authentic scholar one should not believe it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
